quality_checks.repeat_box_caution: Repeated boxes may be a ball held in a hand or an annotation carried across occlusion; identical coordinates alone are not proof of faulty interpolation. Selected pixel probes and manual viewing are required.

manual_scene_observations: First-frame contact sheet shows top-down broadcast views, oblique side views, amateur indoor courts, wheelchair table tennis, singles and doubles.

02/03/04 appear in the same venue; 06/07/08 share broadcast court appearance. Group IDs should be treated as a minimum grouping unit; visually related groups may need to be kept on the same split. Actual match/source IDs are not provided in the annotation schema.
17_001 frame119 has a 146.75px square labeled ball around the near player's torso/thigh area; it is an outlier requiring review, not an automatically confirmed bad label.

Manual first/last-frame viewing of the three longest repeated-box runs (18_006 frames4-41, 13_001 frames38-50, 13_005 frames5-16) shows a player in a pre-serve held-ball posture. The longest run is visually near-static (whole-frame mean pixel difference 0.316/255). This supports near-duplicate-frame leakage risk but is insufficient evidence to label these runs as erroneous interpolation.
